payload.name: the Counting House
payload.description: A basalt-faced hall that straddles the boundary between the Upper and Lower cities, its vaulted interior always smelling of ink, candle-wax, and old money. Above ground the patriars' coin-clerks argue over ledgers behind iron grilles; below ground the Guild has long kept its own set of books. The Absolute crisis scarcely touched the facade — the sums still balance, the fees are still collected — but the personnel have changed, and the trapdoor to the lower vaults opens a fraction more freely than it used to.
